sequence.name: CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Configure
sequence.block:
// Configure Write32(ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x304, 0x00000003); // FFCR: Enable Formatter and Trigger Insertion Write32(ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x01C, ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___TRIGGER_COUNT); // TRG: Number of words to capture after trigger Write32(ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x018, 0x00000000); // Init RwP Write32(ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x014, 0x00000000); // Init RRP
Write32(ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x020, 0x00000001); // Enable ETB
__ap = savedAP; Message(0, "End CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Configure @0x%08X, AP 0x%08X", ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS, ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___AP);

sequence.name: CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Capture
CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Flush

control.info: Wait for ETB manual flush to complete
Wait for ETB to become ready

sequence.block: __ap = savedAP; Message(0, "End CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Flush @0x%08X, AP 0x%08X", ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS, ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___AP);

sequence.name: CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Read_Buffer
sequence.block: __ap = savedAP; Message(0, "End CS_ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___Read_Buffer @0x%08X, AP 0x%08X", ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS, ETB___INSTANCE_INDEX___AP);
